text:
sara: FYI - HelioMed sent PO #HM-2026-01. They marked Tax-Exempt, Net30 -> Net45 request, and appended a BYO-KMS clause plus an EU residency appendix for operations in DE. They want to e-sign today to start the POC. Can we accept PO + e-sign or do we need countersign / finance pre-approval?
eli_legal: Please paste the PO and any redlines. BYO-KMS sounds like a liability item. Net45 for a first-time customer usually needs credit review. @finance please advise.
sara: PO snippet: ```PO HM-2026-01
Payment: Net45 requested
Tax: Exempt (will provide cert)
KMS: Customer-managed HSM (BYO-KMS)
Residency: EU only (Germany)
Signature: Customer requests DocuSign single-envelope for PO + Order Form
```
jordan_se: They want POC on our hosted offering but insist BYO-KMS for compliance. They also asked to pin model=redwood-llm-v1.2 for the trial and include a path to Dedicated with throughput SLOs after POC.
meera_sec: BYO-KMS is only supported for Dedicated/Private. Hosted defaults to Redwood-managed keys. If they force BYO-KMS on Hosted that's a security/control blocker. We need HSM attestations (FIPS 140-2/3), key rotation policy, and ACL docs.
eli_legal: Proposed route: 1) Offer DocuSign envelope containing Order Form + 1-page BYO-KMS addendum + DPA annex. 2) Require that BYO-KMS is valid only on Dedicated/Private; Hosted start permitted without BYO-KMS. 3) Add indemnity for key management errors.
finance: Net45 OK after credit check. Need signed order + invoice contact + tax-exempt certificate. For EU customers provide VAT/tax docs.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared (Order Form + BYO-KMS addendum + DPA). Sent to procurement contact anna@heliomed.de and eli_legal for signatures.
eli_legal: I'll countersign once finance confirms credit. If deal value >= $250k, exec signature required.
sara: Action items for me: 1) request tax cert + HSM attestation from HelioMed; 2) confirm procurement contact; 3) ask customer to accept Hosted->Dedicated migration plan (no BYO-KMS on Hosted) in writing; 4) attach PO + redlines to envelope. Will update thread when docs arrive.
meera_sec: If customer insists on BYO-KMS for Hosted, escalate and schedule a security onboarding call. That may force Private deployment and add >2 weeks lead time.
jordan_se: Ops note: EU residency will require provisioning in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) for Dedicated. Expect ~7 business days after signed SOW. Include brief SOW for RPS and capacity.
sara: Thanks all. Pausing Hosted BYO-KMS until customer signs the addendum or agrees to Dedicated path. Will circle back when we have the tax cert. :thumbsup:
